description.narrative: At least 10 training programmes are supported with training material on the eLearning Platform.

comment.narrative: 2018 The following courses are available on the e learning platform Office Admin Hospitality and tourism electrical general ICT2019 In 2019 105 selfpaced lessons to support the following 8 qualifications and 6 general subjects Qualifications Airconditioning and Refrigeration Auto mechatronic Bricklaying and Plastering Hospitality Joinery and Cabinet Making Plumbing and Pipe Fitting Welding and Metal Fabrication Solar InstallationGeneral Subjects English and Communication Entrepreneurship HIV Aids Technical Drawing Information Communication Technology Numeracy and Science2020 In 2020 the following 4 qualifications were supported through the eLearning platform in addition to the ones reported on in 2019 Office Administration Electronics Electrical General Wholesale and Retail This brings the total qualifications supported to 12.2021 NVTC Electrical General Office administration Hospitality and Tourism and wholesale and retail
